title: Michael Jackson Music Disc's
description: Michael Jackson (Fabric Mod) can use /mj or /michaeljackson to use the mod.
body:
🎵 Michael Jackson Music Mod (Fabric)
Bring the King of Pop to Minecraft! This mod adds an optimized audio command engine to play, queue, and manage legendary Michael Jackson tracks straight from your chat console.

No More Crashes: Stripped out old UI text code to guarantee full stability on Minecraft 1.20.5+.

Seamless Queuing: Type /mj queue  and hit Tab—the dropdown menu stays open as you space-separate up to 3 songs to play back-to-back.

Smart Audio Controls: Instantly kill the music and wipe the queue with /mj stop, or change your sound levels on the fly with /mj volume [0.0 - 1.0].

Polished Chat UI: Cleaned up text formatting so track names show up fully capitalized and bolded (e.g., Billie Jean instead of billie_jean).

Commands: /mj play, /mj queue, /mj viewqueue, /mj volume, /mj stop (or use /michaeljackson)
